old_description: Specializing in one of a kind custom fabrication and large part runs for manufacturers. SLH Metals’ mission is to supply our customers with high quality metal materials and custom steel fabrication services with competitive pricing and outstanding customers service. We understand and appreciate the many challenges our customers face regarding accuracy, complexity and deadlines. It is our goal to meet and exceed expectations with our product knowledge and our metal fabrication and design abilities.
about:
SLH Metals, Inc. operates from Corunna, Michigan. The business traces its roots to 1965 when S.L. & H. Contractors, Inc. began as a bridge construction company. Surplus steel from that operation was sold locally, and the metals division grew until it spun off as a separate entity in 2006.

Today the company runs a full-service metals and fabrication center. Its shop provides custom metal fabrication, precision laser cutting, welding (including portable welding), laser engraving, and a range of forming processes such as rolling, bending, shearing, burning, and hole punching. It also stocks and sells a variety of raw metal materials, serving both large production runs and one-of-a-kind projects.

The customer base spans automotive, manufacturing, environmental, railroad, aerospace, and agricultural industries, along with walk-in clients ranging from hobbyists to local farmers. The company emphasizes its ability to handle complex, accuracy-sensitive work on tight deadlines.

SLH Metals states its mission is to deliver high-quality materials and services at competitive prices with outstanding customer service. It was founded to meet the challenges its customers face regarding accuracy, complexity, and deadlines, aiming to exceed expectations through product knowledge and fabrication expertise.

name: S&S Welding & Fabrication LLC
old_description: We have been serving the community and surrounding areas of Lexington, South Carolina, since 1987.  And for the past 38 years, we have expanded our working facilities, equipment, and working range to include not only the State of South Carolina, but the entire eastern seaboard and beyond.
about:
S&S Welding & Fabrication LLC operates from Lexington, South Carolina, where it was founded in 1987 by brothers Kenneth and Cecil Shumpert after they were laid off from Champion Road Machinery. The business began in a two-car concrete-block garage with their mother managing the office, and it has remained family-owned through multiple expansions.

The company provides comprehensive welding and fabrication services, including MIG, TIG (aluminum and steel), and stick welding, CNC plasma and oxy-fuel cutting on a 70-by-240-inch table, general machining (milling, turning, threading, boring, keyways), metal shearing (up to 5/8-inch mild steel, 3/8-inch stainless), bending (up to 14 feet), rolling (up to 10 feet wide), and pipe/angle/channel rolling. It also offers portable welding via three crane-equipped service trucks, portable line boring, dustless blasting with a rust inhibitor that delays flash rust for up to 72 hours, and powder coating in a 12-by-10-by-30-foot booth with a matching oven. The shop houses a 15-ton overhead crane and multiple welding stations.

S&S serves a broad customer base across the eastern seaboard, including county governments, emergency services, small and large businesses, and farmers. Its project experience spans fresh water and wastewater treatment plants, emergency vehicles, farm equipment, tractor trailers, filter presses, conveyors, fencing and gates, water tanks, and construction equipment such as backhoes and bulldozers.

The company emphasizes a "no job too big, no job too small" philosophy, citing its commitment to detail, safety, and customer satisfaction as differentiators. It highlights its multi-generational family involvement, continued investment in equipment like the CNC plasma table and dustless blasting systems, and the ability to mobilize portable services to job sites.

about:
S.B. International, Inc. (SBI) was founded in 1982 in Nashville, Tennessee. The company began as a supplier of valvetrain components for automotive and heavy-duty engine markets, establishing a focus on product quality and availability.

SBI manufactures and supplies a comprehensive range of valvetrain components, including valve seat inserts, valves, valve keepers, valve stem seals, valve guides, valve springs, injector tubes, lifters, rocker arm components, pushrods, head saver shims, valve spring retainers and rotators, head bolts, and K-Line bronze valve guide liners. The company also offers Precision Engine Parts (PEP) product lines for domestic and diesel performance applications, supported by a technical service team and an online e-catalog.

The company serves the automotive, light and medium-duty truck, small to heavy-duty diesel truck and equipment, agricultural tractor, marine, and industrial engine markets worldwide. Its customers include engine parts distributors, production rebuilders, and specialty engine builders.

SBI emphasizes customer and technical service as key differentiators, offering worldwide distribution and up-to-date product availability. The company expanded its portfolio through acquisitions, including Ertel in 2001 and a partnership with K-Line Industries in 2008.

Glas- und Carbonfasergelege, Kernmaterialien und technischer Support entlang ihrer Wertschöpfungskette erleichtern die Fertigung und sichern langlebige, effiziente und ressourcenschonende Bauteile.
about:
SAERTEX USA, LLC is headquartered in Huntersville, North Carolina. The company operates as the U.S. subsidiary of the global SAERTEX Group, a German-based producer of textile reinforcement materials for composite structures.

The company manufactures multiaxial and unidirectional non-crimp fabrics (NCF) from glass, carbon, aramid, and natural fibers, along with core materials such as SAERfoam and SAERcore. SAERTEX supports customers from initial material development through series production, providing engineering services and a digital laminate calculator. The group operates 17 production and service locations across five continents.

SAERTEX serves the wind energy, aerospace, automotive, marine, mobility and transport, infrastructure and construction, sport and leisure, and pipe rehabilitation sectors. Documented projects include supplying reinforcement fabrics for CAPiTA snowboards, GATTO shipyard’s hybrid ferries, the Norman Foster Foundation’s roof in Madrid, Aventura Yachts catamarans, Steiner truck bodies, Ekin Muovi bus components, and Scania city buses.

The company emphasizes its global footprint and integrated service model—combining material development, processing expertise, and on-site technical support—as its primary differentiator, enabling customers to realize lightweight, durable composite structures.

old_description: SATMED Health is a leading provider of innovative medical equipment, dedicated to delivering patient-centric, high-quality healthcare solutions. Empowering healthcare through technology and expertise.
about:
SATMED Health LLC operates dual headquarters in New York, New York, and Hong Kong SAR, with global design hubs in the United States and Australia. The company was founded on a commitment to precision and clinical excellence in radiology consumables and medical imaging solutions, led by CEO and CFO Carol Si.

As a OEM and ODM manufacturer, SATMED Health produces contrast media delivery systems, CT/MRI/interventional injectors, radiology drapes, and multi-use syringe systems under brands such as SATDrape, SATPro, SATSyringe, and SATLine. Manufacturing occurs across CE-, FDA-, and ISO-accredited factories in Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Shanghai, and Wuhan, utilizing automated sterile production lines for high-capacity output. The direct-to-factory model eliminates intermediaries, offering custom medical manufacturing and high-volume wholesale orders supported by global land, air, and sea logistics.

The company serves radiology, cardiology, and interventional medicine departments in hospitals worldwide, including specialized support for developing nations. Its portfolio targets clinical workflows in diagnostic imaging and interventional procedures, with products designed to optimize hospital procurement and patient safety.

SATMED Health differentiates itself through a sustainability focus—claiming 80% plastic reduction via multi-use syringe systems—and a turnkey support model spanning market analysis, clinical education, and technical support. The firm leverages over 30 years of collective experience in radiology and cardiology among its advisory board of physicians and medical physics experts.

old_description: That's why Steve Salansky founded SAVKAT in 2017. Named after his daughter Savannah Kathryn, this company carries a name he's personally accountable for. When you call us, you're calling Bristol, CT—not a call center in another state.
about:
SAVKAT was founded in 2017 in Bristol, Connecticut, by Steve Salansky, who named the company after his daughter Savannah Kathryn. The business began as a family-owned venture in West Hartford before expanding to serve greater New England, with a mission to make premium renewable energy systems accessible to homeowners.

The company provides complete home energy and protection services, including solar energy system design and installation, GAF-certified roofing, battery backup (FranklinWH, Tesla Powerwall, Enphase), EV charging, and solar panel removal and reinstallation. All work is performed by in-house crews—sales, engineering, permitting, installation, and service—without subcontractors. SAVKAT has completed over 3,500 residential installations and offers a 25-year comprehensive warranty.

SAVKAT serves residential homeowners across Connecticut and greater New England, helping them achieve energy independence through solar, storage, and roofing solutions. The company also works with customers seeking battery backup for grid resilience and EV charging integration. Its technology-agnostic approach means it selects equipment from brands such as Enphase, FranklinWH, REC, Qcells, and SolarEdge based on each home's needs.

Salansky founded SAVKAT to offer a local alternative to national solar chains that rely on subcontractors and distant call centers. The company emphasizes accountability: one team, one warranty, one phone number, and crews that are direct employees. It also leverages nearby warehousing for faster material delivery and quicker installations.

name: SEA Wire and Cable, Inc.
old_description: SEA is the largest stocking distributor of Isodyne. We have a tremendous and broad availability of parts as well as the purchasing power to provide you with the best market cost possible. Isodyne’s connector backshell Tool-less Braid Termination System was specifically designed to provide better mechanical and electrical performance for wire harnesses requiring shielding protection for EMI/RFI, HIRF, and lightning. Both the individual shields and the overbraid are terminated at the backshell with one band. Our spring band can be installed and removed thousands of times with no tools allowing for easy re-entry of the cable assembly for repair or re-pinning and no degradation of spring force. The Isodyne backshell system has been in use since 1990 on land, sea, air, and space platforms requiring a higher performance connector backshell.
about:
SEA Wire and Cable, Inc. is headquartered in Madison, Alabama. The company traces its roots to 1970 when Gary Griffin founded South Eastern Associates as a manufacturer's representative firm. In 1982 the business was incorporated as SEA Wire and Cable and shifted its focus to stocking and distributing military-specification wire and cable. The operation moved to the Madison area in 1977 and expanded its warehouse and office space several times through the 1980s. In the early 2000s the company became a small woman-owned business when Griffin transferred ownership to his daughter, Dana Town, who continues to lead the firm.

Today SEA operates as a broad-line distributor of mil-aero wire, cable, heat-shrink tubing, termination sleeves, cable ties, EMI/RFI backshells and related harnessing components. The company maintains an 80,000-square-foot facility stocked with more than 15,000 line items and over 80 million feet of wire. Beyond distribution, SEA provides value-added services including laser wire marking, custom color coding, dyeing, cut-and-strip operations, planetary twisting, kitting, sub-assembly, and a suite of electrical tests such as hipot, spark, pull and solderability checks. It also manages customer inventory through Kanban, just-in-time, dock-to-stock, consignment and other programs, and ships in-stock orders the same day.

The customer base spans military, aerospace and commercial sectors, with named accounts that include Boeing, Unison Industries and Lockheed Martin. SEA's quality system is certified to AS9100 and ISO 9001, and the company emphasizes full traceability back to the original manufacturer, retaining certificates of conformance and test reports for every lot.

SEA's stated mission is to take care of its customers, partners, employees, stakeholders and the warfighter "one connection at a time." Its core values — Service, Excellence, Accountability — underpin a quality program that targets zero defects through comprehensive incoming inspection and root-cause corrective action.

name: SINTX Technologies
old_description: SINTX is a leading manufacturer of silicon nitride and other advanced ceramics. Silicon nitride is a very hard, abrasion- and corrosion-resistant ceramic solid that’s inherently antibacterial and antiviral. SINTX has been innovating with this material since 1996 and expanded to manufacture other advanced ceramics in 2021.
about:
SINTX Technologies operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1996. The company is publicly traded on the NASDAQ under the ticker SINT. Its origins trace back to the development of technical ceramic and composite components for biomedical, aerospace, defense, and energy markets, with a focus on silicon nitride innovation since its inception.

The company manufactures silicon nitride and other advanced ceramics, controlling the entire process in-house from powder preparation through final inspection. Capabilities include powder preparation, mechanical and isostatic dry pressing, green machining with up to 5-axis capability, debinding, sintering, hot isostatic pressing, and quality control. An R&D cell supports compounding, extrusion, and 3D printing of silicon nitride-containing polymer composites, while an R&D lab provides powder characterization, microscopy, and pathogen testing. The FDA- and ANVISA-registered facility serves prototype to production volumes.

SINTX serves biomedical, aerospace, defense, and energy sectors. In the biomedical space, it produces silicon nitride spinal implants and hip/knee prosthetic components with demonstrated antibacterial and osseointegrative properties. Its FleX SN-AP antipathogenic powder is being evaluated as an additive or coating for medical and non-medical products. The company has also secured a supply agreement with Evonik to manufacture a silicon nitride–PEEK compound for AI-assisted, 3D-printed parts.

SINTX distinguishes itself as one of the few firms capable of manufacturing silicon nitride products completely in-house for medical devices. Full control over powder preparation enables tailored material properties, and private-label partnerships allow customers to leverage validated designs under their own brands.

about:
SML Packaging Solutions, LLC was founded in 2005 in the Lynchburg, Virginia area and is now headquartered in Forest, Virginia. The company was established to design and build custom packing machinery for the glass and plastic bottling industry, drawing on what it describes as more than 150 years of combined engineering expertise among its team.

The company manufactures a line of case packers and inspection equipment, including the Glass House Packer, Drop Case Packer, Small Brewery Case Packer, Variety Pack Line, and Case Checker, along with drop grids and clamps compatible with major case packers. The Drop Case Packer is rated at up to 30 cases per minute (43,200 bottles per hour) and handles glass or plastic bottles and jars of various shapes. The Small Brewery Case Packer operates at 30 to 350 bottles per minute in a compact footprint suited for tight spaces. All machines are designed for 24/7 operation and can be customized for specific bottle sizes, pack configurations, and production requirements.

SML serves the craft brewing, glass packaging, and high-speed bottling sectors, with equipment used for liquor flasks, beer and wine bottles, pickle jars, and other round or non-round containers. Customers range from growing breweries needing cost-effective automation to high-volume bottling lines requiring heavy-duty, continuous-duty machinery.

The company emphasizes heavy-duty construction, long service life, and total customization as its distinguishing factors, stating that its machines are built for effortless operation, maximum efficiency, and durability in demanding production environments.

name: SRC Automotive Inc
old_description: SRC Automotive® is owned by its workforce. This structure drives our employees to maintain the highest quality standards, as each has a personal stake in the company's success. Our employee-ownership model ensures excellence in every product we deliver.
about:
SRC Automotive operates from Springfield, Missouri, as an employee-owned manufacturer structured around an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). The ownership model ties each worker's stake to the company's performance, a design intended to align daily decisions with long-term quality outcomes.

The company remanufactures gasoline, LPG, natural-gas, and marine engines, and also produces newly assembled and industrial engines. Its shop runs 5-axis CNC machining centers, and a dedicated R&D department operates dynamometer test cells for each fuel type. Every unit undergoes complete disassembly, with all components returned to specification using genuine OEM or OEM-validated parts before final testing.

Customers span automotive, marine, and industrial sectors. The remanufactured engines serve as lower-cost service replacements for OEM brands, while the newly assembled and industrial lines address original-equipment and aftermarket demand. The dynamometer capability supports validation across gasoline, LPG, natural-gas, and marine applications.

SRC Automotive positions its process as distinct from repair or rebuild: complete disassembly, specification restoration, OEM-grade parts, and full test cycles backed by warranty. The company also cites its certifications — IATF 16949:2016, ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 14001:2015 — and a circular-economy approach that reduces resource consumption and waste.
